title: Dedication of Part I
paragraphs: To the Duke of Béjar, Marquis of Gibraleón, Count of Benalcázar and Bañares, Viscount of Puebla de Alcocer, lord of the towns of Capilla, Curiel and Burguillos.

Knowing the welcome and honor Your Excellency extends to books of every kind, as a prince disposed to favor the worthy arts, especially those whose nobility will not submit to the service or favors of the crowd, I have decided to publish The Ingenious Gentleman Don Quixote of La Mancha under the protection of Your Excellency’s illustrious name. With the respect due to such high rank, I ask you to receive it kindly under your protection. In that shelter, although it lacks the precious adornment of elegance and learning that clothes works composed in the houses of scholars, it may confidently face the judgment of those who overstep the bounds of their own ignorance and condemn other people’s writings with more severity than justice. I earnestly hope that Your Excellency’s wise regard for my honorable purpose will not disdain so humble and modest a service.
